spans.s:
preṅkhá, a. rocking, pitching; as m. n.
unsteady boat, skiff. [√īṅkh + pra.]

préta, ppl. gone onward, i. e. departed,
dead; as m.
 —1. dead man;
 —2. ghost.
[√i + pra.]

prétya, grd. after dying, i. e. in the other
world (opp. to iha). [√i + pra, 992.]

préṣṭha, a. very pleasant. [√prī, 470^4:
serves as superl. to priya.]

preṣya, grdv. to be sent; as m. servant.
[√2iṣ, ‘send,’ + pra.]
